alt: Heme breakdown pathway, labelled in Galician. In the macrophage: heme to biliverdin (heme oxygenase) to bilirubin (biliverdin reductase); bilirubin passes down the bile duct to the intestine, where bacteria remove glucuronic acid to give urobilinogen (stercobilinogen) and then stercobilin, with part returning to the liver in the enterohepatic circulation.
